name: amzn-selling-partner-codegen
description: oagen-based generator for the amzn_selling_partner Python package

scripts.sdk:generate: npm run spec:build && npm run sdk:generate:python -- --spec .build/openapi.json --namespace Client --output ../src/amzn_selling_partner/sdk && npm run spec:build -- --petstore && npm run sdk:generate:python -- --spec .build/petstore.json --namespace Client --output ../tests/petstore_sdk && npm run format
